context: Ren and Mei reflect on an independence documentary.
purpose: Casual reflective register reusing stragglers (まさに/つて/いれ/そのもの/知れ) naturally.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: あの番組、人生そのものを描いてたね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、まさに本物の物語だったよ。
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reflective delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼は、つてもなく始めたんでしょう?
lines.en: He started with no connections, right?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、力を全部入れて挑んだんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, he put all his strength in and took it on.
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 努力そのものが、報われたんだね。
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: つてに頼らず、よくやったと知れるね。
lines.en: Without connections — you can tell he did well.
lines.style: admiring young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私も、心を入れて頑張ろうと思えた。
lines.en: It made me feel I should put my heart in and try.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm inspired delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まさに、勇気をもらえる話だったね。
lines.en: Truly a story that gives courage.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
